default_entry: code/road_capacity_cpu_entry.py; --execute always exits3 before any backend import

canonical.init: same native-sRGB c0 from unchanged old S2; both learned corrections exactly zero

primary_pair.name: W4
primary_pair.parameterization: shared metric-world-XY bilinear sRGB correction delta_F

shader.mapping: clip(c0_i + delta_i, 0, 1); W4 delta_i=bilinear(delta_F, own fixed worldXY_i)
shader.color_space: native reference-camera sRGB appearance; no linearRGB-to-sRGB remap
shader.world_chart: global worldXY in meters; origin=floor(min canonical active worldXY/0.04)*0.04; integer texel centers
shader.precision: float64 coordinates/weights/accumulation, float32 correction and shader RGB
shader.guard_policy: same fixed eligible row scope in both arms; ineligible/K/near rows use exact c0 override; no atlas-texel freezing that erodes neighboring rows
shader.continuous_field_boundary: raw delta field and effective row overrides are exported separately; texture-coordinate inside is not legal-road or known-material certification
shader.convexity_boundary: W4 with shared basis and shader clipping is not a simple box-LS global-optimum certificate; only independent fixed-coverage RGB oracle has that convex capacity interpretation

common_color_only_draft.photo: actual fixed-coverage native black-background premult sRGB versus fixed alpha times same teacher; never RGB/alpha
common_color_only_draft.prior_normalization: same effective row RGB correction mean over common eligible rows/channels, not parameter-count mean
common_color_only_draft.loss_role: same target pack/masks/q/weights/sampler in a pair; A/C/S separated and normalized independently if real teacher pack selected
common_color_only_draft.new_shadow_loss_weight: pending parent protocol; no implicit default
common_color_only_draft.engineering_smoke_updates: to be preregistered before any authorized GPU execution, separately counted

conditional_control.name: I_reg
conditional_control.parameterization: I0 plus fixed metric-world neighbor TV of delta only; frozen c0 details unpenalized
conditional_control.interpretation: if I_reg also meets joint fit/detail/stripe criteria, shared atlas is not established as necessary

target_roles.ideal_capacity: QA independent world analytic field through frozen G_s surface/cameras; all five views supervised oracle, never held-out generalization; same targets for I0/W4
target_roles.real_teacher: static_handoff supervision_v4 candidate, true visible A / physical-hole C / explicitly target-associated shadow S; C/S raw frozen2D teacher, not F0 projection
target_roles.new_scope_requirement: GPU after user authorization must recompute actual alphaT contributions for selected target pack, including new S; no automatic reuse of legacy real A/C scope
target_roles.scope_API: scope_source and source_role are mandatory; legacy static preview cannot be converted into a render packet or road bake
target_roles.S_seen: audit actual S contribution separately; S-only known prior rows must not be silently excluded by the old C-only-known rule; parent must explicitly authorize effective-RGB override while immutable observed prior ledger stays frozen
target_roles.constraint_floor: S or other targets blocked by physical/K/near scope remain explicit constraint floor; do not force fit or attribute to completion prior

frequency_detail_registration.subpixel_stress: diagnostic only; do not force unresolvable paint/dash phase into detail truth
frequency_detail_registration.numeric_acceptance_thresholds: parent to lock before GPU; descriptive frequency quantities are not new retrospective thresholds

CPU_evidence_scope.legacy_preview: check3/basis_statistics_4cm.json uses historical direct-teacher r4 real A/C scopes and frozen masses only to establish sharing/rank; not new V4/ideal authorization

next_action: stop after CPU preparation and wait for the user to open/authorize GPU; no controller or automatic continuation
